Package dev.relism.flash.routing

Class Cors

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.routing.Cors
All Implemented Interfaces:
Middleware
public final class Cors extends Object implements Middleware
Cross-origin requests, as a middleware. Answers a preflight itself, on any path, before routing decides anything; adds the allow headers to every other request from an allowed origin. Every header is encoded once, here; a request only compares bytes. 

 app.use(Cors.allow("https://app.example").methods("GET", "POST").headers("Authorization", "Content-Type"));

expose(java.lang.String...) names the response headers a page script may read beyond the safelisted ones.
